**Description:**

A pipeline for filtering out non-neutral TCRb clonotype trajectories in the blood of ICB-treated patients is based on removing the natural variability of the TCR repertoire characterized in healthy individuals, and includes additional filters to remove background noise caused by technological bias. Once non-neutral clonotypes have been identified, distance matrix-based k means clustering groups the trajectories into distinct waves of expansion or contraction.

# annot

Annotate TCRb trajectories with all available information.

For that, first, load data to be annotated.

```{r}
data.set <- "pbl_raw_RIO136.tsv"
path <- "/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/manuscript/panels and plots/TCRb trajectories"
pt <- "RIO136"
min_freq <- 0.0025

data <- read.table(file.path(path, "results", pt, data.set), sep = "\t", header = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(TRBV = str_extract(nucleotide, "TCRBV[0-9]+-0?[0-9]"),
         TRBV = gsub("-0", "-", TRBV),
         TRBV = gsub("TCRBV0", "TCRBV", TRBV),
         TRBV = gsub("TCRBV", "TRBV", TRBV),
         TRBJ = str_extract(nucleotide, "TCRBJ[0-9]+-0?[0-9]"),
         TRBJ = gsub("-0", "-", TRBJ),
         TRBJ = gsub("TCRBJ0", "TCRBJ", TRBJ),
         TRBJ = gsub("TCRBJ", "TRBJ", TRBJ),
  ) %>%
  mutate(TCRb = paste0(aminoAcid, "_", TRBV, "_", TRBJ)) %>%
  select(-traj)
```

Annotate CD4 or CD8 based on single-cell data.

```{r}
library(Seurat)

sc.data.cd8 <- readRDS("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/single_cell/sc_pipeline/patients/RIO136/seurat/int_cd8.rds")@meta.data
cd8 <- unique(sc.data.cd8$TCRb)

sc.data.cd4 <- readRDS("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/single_cell/sc_pipeline/patients/RIO136/seurat/int_cd4.rds")@meta.data
cd4 <- unique(sc.data.cd4$TCRb)

compartment <- data %>%
  mutate(compartment = case_when(
    TCRb %in% cd4 ~ "cd4",
    TCRb %in% cd8 ~ "cd8",
    TRUE ~ "unknown"
  )) %>%
  select(nucleotide, compartment) %>%
  distinct()

data <- data %>% left_join(compartment, by = "nucleotide")

# Calculate cumulative frequency of both compartments.

cumulative <- data %>%
  select(nucleotide, time, freq_in, compartment) %>%
  group_by(time, compartment) %>%
  summarise(total_freq = sum(freq_in), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = compartment, values_from = total_freq, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(as.numeric(gsub("^d", "", time)))

write.table(cumulative, file.path(path, "results", pt, "cumulative_frequency_cd4_cd8.tsv"), sep = "\t", col.names = TRUE, row.names = FALSE)
```

TCR library clonotypes and known specificity.

```{r}
lib.path <- "/Volumes/labagros/pierre/proj/rootpath/TCR_library_screen/RIO136/TCRlib_rio136/TXTO_TCRTable_VHIOwv1_5Criteria_1001TCRs_20201110_154539.tsv"

tcr_lib <- read_tsv(lib.path, col_names = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(X14 = paste0("TRA:", X3, ";TRB:", X6)) %>%
  select(X1, X2, X3, X4, X5, X6, X7, X14) %>%
  as.data.frame()

colnames(tcr_lib) <- c("id", toupper(c("trav", "tra", "traj", "trbv", "trb", "trbj", "tcr")))
tcr_lib <- tcr_lib %>%
  mutate(
    TRAV = sub("\\*.*", "", TRAV),
    TRAJ = sub("\\*.*", "", TRAJ),
    TRBV = sub("\\*.*", "", TRBV),
    TRBJ = sub("\\*.*", "", TRBJ),
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    TCRb = paste0(TRB, "_", TRBV, "_", TRBJ),
    TCRa = paste0(TRA, "_", TRAV, "_", TRAJ)
  )

# Function to read hits from TCL and TMG library analysis.

load_hits <- function(filename, source_label) {
  df <- try(read.table(filename, header = TRUE, sep = "\t"), silent = TRUE)
  if (inherits(df, "try-error") || nrow(df) == 0) {
    return(data.frame(id = character(0), source = character(0), stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  }
  ids <- gsub("VHIOwv1_", "", rownames(df))
  data.frame(id = ids, source = source_label, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
}

hits_list <- list(
  load_hits("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/libraries/final/RIO136/TCL/color_palette_relevant.txt", "TCL"),
  load_hits("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/libraries/final/RIO136/TMG/color_palette_mix_bulk_maa.txt", "MAA"),
  load_hits("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/libraries/final/RIO136/TMG/color_palette_mix_bulk_cga.txt", "CGA"),
  load_hits("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/libraries/final/RIO136/TMG/color_palette_mix_bulk_tmg1.txt", "TMG1"),
  load_hits("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/libraries/final/RIO136/TMG/color_palette_mix_bulk_tmg2.txt", "TMG2"),
  load_hits("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/libraries/final/RIO136/TMG/color_palette_mix_bulk_tmg3.txt", "TMG3"),
  load_hits("/Users/endikaprieto/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-VHIO/pbl/libraries/final/RIO136/TMG/color_palette_mix_bulk_viral.txt", "Viral")
)

hits_list[["traj"]] <- data.frame(id = paste0("ChosenID.", c(145,185,216)), 
                                  source = "Traj")
hits_list[["non_reactive"]] <- data.frame(id = c(paste0("ChosenID.", c(2,56,57,74,99,131,136,170,198,247,272,285,646,671,746,819)), paste0("ValidationID.", c(25,34,45))), 
                                          source = "Non_reactive")

all_hits <- do.call(rbind, hits_list) %>% group_by(id) %>% summarise(source = paste(sort(unique(source)), collapse = "+"), .groups = "drop") %>% as.data.frame()
write.table(all_hits, file = file.path(path, "results", pt, "final_reactivities_RIO136.tsv"), sep = "\t", col.names = TRUE)

tcr_lib <- tcr_lib %>% left_join(all_hits, by = "id")
data <- data %>% left_join(tcr_lib %>% select(TCRb, id, source), by = "TCRb")
```

Complete data for plotting longitudinal trajectories.

```{r}

metadata <- data %>% select(-time, -freq_in, -log10value, -count) %>% distinct()
timepoints <- unique(data$time)

data <- data %>%
  select(nucleotide, time, freq_in, count) %>%
  complete(nucleotide,
           time = timepoints,
           fill = list(freq_in = min_freq, count = 0)
           ) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = "nucleotide") %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  distinct() %>% 
  mutate(log10value = log10(freq_in))

```

# plots

PBL repertoire.

```{r}

compartment_colors <- c(
  cd4 = "orange",
  cd8 = "blue3",
  unknown = "gray"
)

max.freq <- 100
plots_annot_traj <- list()

data.plot <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), compartment != "unknown") %>%
  mutate(time = as.numeric(gsub("d", "", time))) %>%
  group_by(compartment) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(compartment, " (n=", n_distinct(nucleotide), ")")) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_a <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = data.plot,
            aes(x = time, y = log10value, group = nucleotide, color = compartment),
            linewidth = 0.1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = log10(c(min_freq, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, max.freq)),
    labels = c(as.character(min_freq), "0.001", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", max.freq),
    limits = c(log10(min_freq), log10(max.freq))
  ) +
  labs(y = "frequency", color = "Compartment") +
  facet_wrap(~compartment, ncol = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_colors) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
    aspect.ratio = 0.5
  )

# Pie chart 1: nucleotide counts per compartment
pie_data <- data.plot %>%
  group_by(compartment) %>%
  summarise(n_count = n_distinct(nucleotide)) %>%
  mutate(percent = n_count / sum(n_count) * 100,
         label = paste0(compartment, "\n", round(percent, 1), "%"))

plot_b <- ggplot(pie_data, aes(x = "", y = n_count, fill = compartment)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, colour = "white") +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_colors) +
  labs(title = "Overall repertoire")

# Pie chart 2: sum of freq_in per compartment
pie_data_freq <- data.plot %>%
  group_by(compartment) %>%
  summarise(total_freq = sum(freq_in)) %>%
  mutate(percent = total_freq / sum(total_freq) * 100,
         label = paste0(compartment, "\n", round(percent, 1), "%"))

plot_c <- ggplot(pie_data_freq, aes(x = "", y = total_freq, fill = compartment)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_colors) +
  labs(title = "Non-neutral repertoire")

plots_annot_traj[["compartment"]] <- wrap_plots(wrap_plots(plot_b, plot_c, ncol = 2),  plot_a, nrow = 2)
print(plots_annot_traj[["compartment"]])

```


TCR library trajectories + specificity.

```{r}

plots_annot_traj <- list()

# TCRlib.

data.plot <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(id), compartment != "unknown") %>%
  mutate(time = as.numeric(gsub("d", "", time))) %>%
  group_by(compartment) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(compartment, " (n=", n_distinct(nucleotide), ")")) %>%
  ungroup()

highlighted <- data.plot %>% filter(!is.na(source))
background <- data.plot %>% filter(is.na(source))

category_colors <- c(
  MAA = "#1f77b4",
  TMG1 = "#ff7f0e",
  TMG2 = "#2ca02c",
  TMG3 = "#d62728",
  non_reactive = "gray30",
  "non_reactive+Viral" = "gray50",
  Traj = "#9467bd",
  Viral = "#17becf",
  TCL = "#e377c2"
)

plots_annot_traj[["TCRlib_by_specificity"]] <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = background,
            aes(x = time, y = log10value, group = nucleotide),
            colour = "grey70",
            linewidth = 0.1) +
  geom_line(data = highlighted,
            aes(x = time, y = log10value, group = nucleotide, colour = source),
            linewidth = 0.33) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = log10(c(min_freq, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, max.freq)),
    labels = c(as.character(min_freq), "0.001", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", max.freq),
    limits = c(log10(min_freq), log10(max.freq))
  ) +
  labs(y = "frequency") +
  facet_grid(compartment ~ source) +
  scale_color_manual(values = category_colors) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
    aspect.ratio = 0.5
  )

print(plots_annot_traj[["TCRlib_by_specificity"]])

```

Trajectory and distribution of p136.Tfrozen_TCRB.in.frame.

```{r}

compartment_colors <- c(
  cd4 = "orange",
  cd8 = "blue3",
  unknown = "gray"
)

data.plot <- data %>%
  filter(p136.Tfrozen_TCRB.in.frame == "Y") %>%
  mutate(time = as.numeric(gsub("d", "", time))) %>%
  group_by(compartment) %>%
  mutate(label = paste0(compartment, " (n=", n_distinct(nucleotide), ")")) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_a <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(data = data.plot,
            aes(x = time, y = log10value, group = nucleotide, color = compartment),
            linewidth = 0.1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  scale_x_continuous() +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = log10(c(min_freq, 0.001, 0.01, 0.1, 1, 10, max.freq)),
    labels = c(as.character(min_freq), "0.001", "0.01", "0.1", "1", "10", max.freq),
    limits = c(log10(min_freq), log10(max.freq))
  ) +
  labs(y = "frequency", color = "Compartment") +
  facet_wrap(~compartment, ncol = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = compartment_colors) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.2),
    aspect.ratio = 0.5
  )

# Pie chart 1: nucleotide counts per compartment
pie_data <- data.plot %>%
  group_by(compartment) %>%
  summarise(n_count = n_distinct(nucleotide)) %>%
  mutate(percent = n_count / sum(n_count) * 100,
         label = paste0(compartment, "\n", round(percent, 1), "%"))

plot_b <- ggplot(pie_data, aes(x = "", y = n_count, fill = compartment)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, colour = "white") +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_colors) +
  labs(title = "Unique clonotype dist")

# Pie chart 2: sum of freq_in per compartment
pie_data_freq <- data.plot %>%
  group_by(compartment) %>%
  summarise(total_freq = sum(freq_in)) %>%
  mutate(percent = total_freq / sum(total_freq) * 100,
         label = paste0(compartment, "\n", round(percent, 1), "%"))

plot_c <- ggplot(pie_data_freq, aes(x = "", y = total_freq, fill = compartment)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), size = 3, color = "white") +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = compartment_colors) +
  labs(title = "Cumulative frequency")

plots_annot_traj[["p136.Tfrozen_TCRB.in.frame"]] <- plot_a | wrap_plots(plot_b, plot_c, ncol = 1)
print(plots_annot_traj[["p136.Tfrozen_TCRB.in.frame"]])

```
